construction.description: White metal fencing, red-and-white bollards, paving materials, and a site container occupy the right side of the roadway and sidewalk, leaving a narrowed contraflow passage.

analysis.weather: Dry pavement with partly cloudy daylight and good visibility
analysis.interesting: The works create a narrow two-way pinch with temporary yellow lane markings. Traffic is passing through, but the available carriageway is substantially narrowed. The Powder Tower is visible in the distance.
analysis.scene_description: Urban street view toward the Powder Tower with moderate moving traffic, several curb-parked cars, and active-looking construction fencing and materials along the right side. Pedestrians are using the sidewalks, and no clear traffic violations or incidents are visible.
